title: Initial Samsung JARVIS prototype
details: Created the first Android/Samsung JARVIS project and began the location-learning and navigation concept.

title: Testing build
details: Created a testable Android build for the Note10+ and continued the location-learning foundation.

title: Build-system correction
details: Adjusted the Android Gradle Plugin/toolchain after the Gradle compatibility problem.

title: Modern Android build
details: Moved the project to a newer Android Gradle Plugin/toolchain, Java 17, compile SDK 35, and Room.

title: Room metadata fix
details: Updated the Room setup to address Kotlin metadata compatibility.

title: First working phone build
details: Fixed the AppCompat theme/startup issue. The app successfully ran on the Note10+ and voice commands worked through Android speech recognition.

title: Wake-word development
details: Worked on a continuous wake-word listener and corrected Kotlin/service issues.

title: Active development line
details: Renamed the development line to Current JARVIS Active v1 and continued wake-word work.

title: Porcupine experiment
details: Tested Picovoice Porcupine wake-word support and fixed build issues, then moved away from the required AccessKey workflow.

title: Offline Vosk wake engine
details: Replaced the wake engine with offline/open-source Vosk and removed Android SpeechRecognizer from the wake service.

title: Voice shutdown commands
details: Added commands such as Stop listening, Turn off listening, Go to sleep, and Shutdown listening.

title: Spoken responses
details: Added Android Text-to-Speech responses to the wake service.

title: Wake response timing
details: Adjusted timing so JARVIS can say Yes? before command recognition starts.

title: Background/lock-screen foundation
details: Added microphone foreground-service handling, persistent notification controls, and battery-management guidance.

title: Voice reliability fixes
details: Improved TTS, microphone startup/error reporting, wake-lock support, and corrected build errors.

title: Google and Maps integration
details: Added Google, Google Search, Google Maps, and navigation commands and fixed coroutine/service execution issues.

title: Speech sequencing
details: Improved speech queueing and command sequencing to reduce response cutoffs.

title: Polished baseline
details: Established the polished JARVIS naming, futuristic UI direction, and retained the working voice/Maps foundation.

title: Stop-learning improvement plan
details: Defined a minimum dwell-time/candidate-stop system so turns and brief pauses are not learned as destinations.

title: Traffic filtering plan
details: Added requirements to distinguish standstill traffic from real destinations using speed patterns, road context, and traffic data when available.

title: Traffic-light filtering plan
details: Added traffic-light/intersection detection so waits at signals are never learned as stops, with GPS/road-behavior fallback when signal data is unavailable.

title: Separate update-log system
details: Added a password-protected update-log button and a separate server architecture so JARVIS can read the project's development history without making the log part of the core JARVIS system.
